verdict.rationale: mParticle documents forwarding customer data to downstream services and connecting it to data-warehousing solutions, which implies an ongoing path for data to reach systems you control. However, nothing in the evidence describes a bulk export of all data in open formats or a documented exit path, and Warehouse Sync is described only as ingesting data into mParticle. Missing for 10: documented full-account or historical bulk export, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON dumps), a documented offboarding or exit path, and independent hands-on confirmation of data portability.
